snippet.title: Dungeon Gals | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A history-rich civilization floating in the sky is in danger of crashing down to earth, and it is up to the Dungeon Gals to save the day! Slice, smash, and blast your way through dangerous dungeons and rustic ruins forgotten by time.

Buy now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2864880/Dungeon_Gals/
https://doricdream.itch.io/dungeon-gals

Buy the soundtrack too! https://doricdream.bandcamp.com/album/dungeon-gals-original-soundtrack
